compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

Update `reviewer-findings.md` contract doc to list all verifier-mutated fields with schemas. Update `record-review.sh` to accept findings with verifier fields without validation errors. Ensure defense-store consumers and `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` tolerate new fields (forward-compat: unknown fields ignored).

## Done Definitions

- `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/reviewer-findings.md` updated with new section "Verifier-Injected Fields" documenting:
  - `verifier_status: "ok" | "failed"` — verifier ran successfully or failed (fail-open)
  - `evidence_invalidated: bool` — re-executed command output differs from reviewer-supplied output
  - `fingerprint: "<path>:<line-start>-<line-end>"` — file region for this ruling
  - Ruling transformations: downgrade-to-minor → severity set to "minor"; drop → finding removed before record-review.sh
- `plugins/dso/scripts/record-review.sh` updated: any finding-level fields not in the base schema are tolerated (not rejected); verifier fields pass through to recorded findings
- `review-defense-store.sh` and `review-github-defense-store.sh` verified forward-compat (grep for rigid field enumeration; add comment if found instructing future maintainers to use forward-compat ignore pattern)
- `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` verified forward-compat (no hard-coded field list)
- Running `tests/scripts/test-record-review-verifier-fields.sh` exits 0 after this task

## File Impact

- `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/reviewer-findings.md` — UPDATED
- `plugins/dso/scripts/record-review.sh` — UPDATED (forward-compat for unknown finding fields)
- `plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh` — REVIEWED (comment added if needed)
- `plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh` — REVIEWED (comment added if needed)
- `plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` — REVIEWED (comment added if needed)
